_readme: Featured images for the blog posts on Blog classico (15), the TYPO3 v14 blog (69) and The TYPO3 blog (390). Generate with packages/site_package/Build/Scripts/generate-library-images.mjs --manifest packages/site_package/Build/Data/blog-image-prompts.json --out packages/site_package/Resources/Private/ContentImages/blog; alt texts are in the language of the site the image belongs to.

styles.home: Editorial photograph for a lifestyle blog. Natural daylight, shallow depth of field, calm palette of warm neutrals with soft spring greens. Realistic and unstaged. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no brand marks, no recognisable faces.
styles.tech: Editorial photograph for a web technology blog. Natural window light, calm palette of warm neutrals with one muted teal accent, modern and uncluttered. No readable screen content, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no recognisable faces.
